caption: The drawing depicts an ornately decorated, oval-shaped container with a removable lid, shown with both pieces slightly separated to display the full surface designs. The container and lid are primarily a light tan or beige color, and both feature a continuous scene rendered in shades of brown, reddish-brown, and muted green. The illustrated scene wraps around both the lid and the body of the container and shows several human figures, all wearing hats, accompanied by dogs and horses. The figures are positioned beneath leafy trees, with some standing, some sitting, and one figure on the right pointing or holding a long object, possibly a firearm. The landscape contains grass, bushes, and a few tree trunks that frame the figures and animals. The top edge of the container’s body is bordered by a blue and white decorative band with geometric or floral motifs. The overall composition is detailed and balanced, with the repeated theme of leisure or hunting activities in a wooded outdoor setting. The background of the drawing itself is plain and off-white, with the word "Hager" subtly written near the bottom right of the image.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
